page.overview:
What is Stanley?

Stanley is an animatronic unicorn that trundles around on a circular track in Charlie's room. He was one of the many toys built by her father Henry and sat alone in her room for years after his death, becoming damaged by the elements.

The Ultimate Guide Description: "A white unicorn animatronic created by Henry for Charlie. Stanley travels on a track around Charlie's room."

Stanley is a little unicorn made of metal and painted glossy white. He also has bared teeth and shiny brown eyes. Stanley's hooves are attached to grooves in the floor, allowing him to trundle around the room on a circular track. When Charlie returns to her father's house, Stanley’s paint is chipped and peeling. His face has also given over to rust, including on his cheeks and around his lively eyes.

In The Twisted Ones, Stanley has been torn from his track. His legs are twisted and his hooves are missing chunks. Stanley’s missing pieces are still attached to the grooves in the floor.
